name: Pocono Mountain School District
hero_alt: Pocono Mountain West High School with newly paved lot
paragraphs: Kobalt Construction wrapped up a 2025 sidewalk replacement project for Pocono Mountain School District, with our crews putting the finishing touches on the work right before student orientation began that Monday — a hard deadline that shaped the whole schedule.

It was a large scope of work completed in a short window, and it took every one of our teams working together: sitework, concrete, and paving crews, coordinated on-site by project manager Chris. Between long hours and close coordination across trades, the crews delivered new sidewalks and paving around Pocono Mountain West High School in time for the new school year.
Projects with a fixed, non-negotiable deadline like the start of a school year leave no room for slippage — and it's exactly the kind of scheduling pressure our team is built to handle.
team_credit: Project Manager: Chris. Trades and suppliers: Corra Concrete, Universal Line Stripe, H&K Group, Four Winds Concrete, and JDM Materials.
